title: Function Privilegechanges
author: reprise99
description: Save as a function in your workspace then invoke via its name, i.e if you save as PrivilegeChanges then call via the same name This function is designed to unify group or privilege changes across on-premises AD and Azure AD It will find changes to privileged AD groups, changes to privileged AAD groups, changes to privileged AAD roles (both directly and via PIM) Default groups and roles have been added, but add your own groups that you wish to monitor unique to your environment By default it will look back one day
